text:
Fear comes on in a motionless
wave. Suddenly, here,
it hints at itself:
the familiar structures, the possible

anticipated consequences (which do not rule out
the worst),
all the slow command of intelligence
and its alternative decisions, all

is clouded in an instant.
And only the root remains,
something like a painful antenna,
fallen one knows not where, still throbbing.

translation.title: Fear Comes On
